change: During recovery reset, verify the actually bound terminal session ID and native history path against the captured recovery evidence before starting authority; refresh deferred binding rather than treating a resume argv or unknown discovery root as proof.
reproduced_defect: The prior release accepted deliberately different native Pi/Codex/Claude sessions and returned running in all three negative cases.
harness_correction: One debug hosted-positive test hit a Windows PermissionError while reading an atomically replaced state file. Its observer now retries only transient read errors for at most 200ms; malformed JSON and persistent errors still fail. The hosted recheck and all 38 release cases passed.
limits: Unfinished-task recovery remains blocked by the existing quiescence guard. This is a prerequisite, not an implementation of replay/reconciliation.
Hosted Codex uses the pre-existing thread/resume returned-thread-ID check; terminal Pi/Codex/Claude are covered by this new binding check.
The latest paid model-backed acceptance remains the preceding bb5a0f6a build; this guard is validated by release fixtures and installed Codex no-model tests.
No production/default controls or account changes.
